class.name: AnimationTree
class.brief_description: A node used for advanced animation transitions in an [AnimationPlayer].
class.description: A node used for advanced animation transitions in an [AnimationPlayer]. [b]Note:[/b] When linked with an [AnimationPlayer], several properties and methods of the corresponding [AnimationPlayer] will not function as expected. Playback and transitions should be handled using only the [AnimationTree] and its constituent [AnimationNode](s). The [AnimationPlayer] node should be used solely for adding, deleting, and editing animations.

method.name: add_shared_parameter
method.description: Adds a shared parameter with the given [param name] and [param default_value]. Shared parameters are named values that any number of node parameters can be bound to with [method bind_parameter], so a single value can drive many parameters at once. The value's type is taken from [param default_value].

method.name: bind_parameter
method.description: Binds the node parameter at [param parameter] to the shared parameter named [param shared_parameter]. The [param parameter] must be a full parameter path, e.g. [code]"parameters/Blend2/blend_amount"[/code]. Bound parameters become read-only and take their value from the shared parameter.

method.name: get_parameter_binding
method.description: Returns the name of the shared parameter that [param parameter] is bound to, or an empty [StringName] if it is not bound.

method.name: get_process_callback
method.description: Returns the process notification in which to update animations.

method.name: get_shared_parameter
method.description: Returns the current value of the shared parameter named [param name].

method.name: get_shared_parameter_list
method.description: Returns the names of all shared parameters.

method.name: get_shared_parameters
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] of all shared parameters and their current values.

method.name: has_shared_parameter
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a shared parameter named [param name] exists.

method.name: remove_shared_parameter
method.description: Removes the shared parameter named [param name] and clears any bindings that referenced it.

method.name: set_process_callback
method.description: Sets the process notification in which to update animations.

method.name: set_shared_parameter
method.description: Sets the current value of the shared parameter named [param name].

method.name: set_shared_parameters
method.description: Replaces all shared parameters with the given [param parameters] [Dictionary] mapping names to values.

method.name: unbind_parameter
method.description: Removes the binding for the node parameter at [param parameter], letting it use its own value again.

members.member: The path to the [Node] used to evaluate the [AnimationNode] [Expression] if one is not explicitly specified internally.
The path to the [AnimationPlayer] used for animating.

A [Dictionary] of shared parameter names to their current values. Shared parameters can be bound to node parameters with [method bind_parameter] so that one value drives many parameters. Shared parameters are added, removed and edited in the AnimationTree inspector.
The root animation node of this [AnimationTree]. See [AnimationRootNode].

signal.name: animation_player_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the [member anim_player] is changed.
